g.text: returns to the federal government (Medicaid → Medicare)
• Federal oversight: fraud control units and survey and certification are reported nationally only, so the national panel's $0.10 has no DC counterpart and this hundred contains none of it
• Beneficiary shares: DC group totals not in hand, column omitted
• Behavioral health: folded into wrap-around services in the DC source
• Public-company earnings and dual-plan retention: no DC figure
Absent data is left absent. Filling a gap with a share
would produce a modelled figure wearing a measured figure's clothes.
